faq.question: Do you provide QP submission services?
faq.answer: Bimeco provides 3D BIM and CAD documentation support. We work with Qualified Persons (QPs) to ensure that BIM submissions meet authority requirements.

faq.question: What deliverables can I expect for fire protection submissions?
faq.answer: Our team provides coordinated BIM models and annotated 2D drawings compliant with local FSSD requirements. Deliverables typically include Revit models (.rvt), AutoCAD files (.dwg), and PDF submissions for approval.

faq.question: Do I need to provide architectural or structural models?
faq.answer: Yes. Having base architectural and structural models allows us to accurately coordinate the fire protection systems with other trades and ensure compliance with code clearance and mounting requirements.

faq.question: Can you assist with hydraulic calculations?
faq.answer: Yes, we can generate hydraulic calculations and pipe sizing based on your system design. Please provide pump specs, hazard classification, and head pressure requirements where available.

faq.question: Is onsite coordination support available?
faq.answer: Yes. We offer onsite coordination support for clash resolution, BIM coordination meetings, and walkthroughs with the QP or SCDF if needed.

faq.question: Can you support design-and-build fire protection projects?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We frequently work with fire contractors and D&B teams to model, document, and coordinate fire protection layouts in compliance with authority requirements.

faq.question: Do you provide assistance for resubmissions or SCDF comments?
faq.answer: Yes. We provide post-submission support including revisions and updates based on SCDF feedback or QP comments, ensuring compliance throughout the process.

faq.question: Do we need to sign an NDA?
faq.answer: All our fire protection modelers and engineers are bound by NDAs. We are happy to sign a project-specific NDA upon request.
